assumptions.text: Indie game developers lose track of player bug reports scattered across Discord messages.
solo and small-team indie game developers with an active Discord community have this problem.
This solves it: A web app that collects player bug reports posted in a game's Discord server and turns them into a de-duplicated, triaged list for the developer.
These customers can be reached in: online, English-speaking indie game developers.
The founder can build and test it with: Python, Discord bot development, web development; 8 hours a week; 150 EUR.
Enough of these customers would pay for it.
